title: Printing & Stationery
metaTitle: Print Shop Software: Quotes, Jobs & Invoices · Paper & Pen
metaDescription: Quote print jobs fast, track each job from artwork to delivery, keep paper stock counted and bill in OMR with 5% VAT. Built for print shops and stationers.
keywords: print shop software, printing business software, print job tracking, print quotation software, stationery shop billing, printing press erp, print estimating
heroTitle: From quote to printed and paid
heroSubtitle: Quote a print job in minutes, turn the approved quote into a job, track it through production and delivery, and invoice it without re-typing a line. Paper & Pen keeps your jobs, paper stock and books in one place.
heroBullets: Quotes that turn into jobs in one click
Paper and stock counted as you use it

features.title: Fast print quotes
features.desc: Build a quote from your price list, share it on WhatsApp or email, and convert it when the customer says yes.

features.title: Job tracking
features.desc: Each approved order becomes a production job, so you always know what is printing, what is waiting and what is late.

features.title: Paper and stock
features.desc: Count paper, ink and finished stationery by SKU and unit, with stock moving every time you sell or use it.

features.title: Delivery notes
features.desc: Hand over finished work with a delivery note and keep the signed proof on the order.

features.title: Invoices with VAT
features.desc: Bill in OMR with 5% VAT, or any currency and tax rate, straight from the quote or the job.

features.title: Customer history
features.desc: See every quote, job and payment for a customer, so a repeat order takes seconds.

sections.title: One record from the first quote to the last payment
sections.body: A print job changes hands many times: sales quotes it, the customer approves it, production prints it, someone delivers it and accounts collects. In Paper & Pen it is one record the whole way, so nothing is re-typed and nothing is lost between desks. Convert an approved quote into an invoice and a production job in one step.
items: Production sees what to print next
Invoice built from the same lines

sections.title: Stationery sales and paper stock in the same place
sections.body: Sell pens, notebooks and printing at the counter and let stock update itself. Set reorder points on the papers and inks you cannot run out of, and see what each customer and each product earns. Built in Oman with native OMR and 5% VAT, and ready for any currency.
items: Reorder points on paper and ink

faqs.q: Can I quote print jobs with my own prices?
faqs.a: Yes. Add your products and services with your own prices, then build quotes from them. A starter print catalogue is set up for you when you sign up, and you edit it to match your shop.

faqs.q: Can I track a job after the customer approves it?
faqs.a: Yes. With the Manufacturing module, an approved order becomes a production job you can follow until it is done and delivered.
Yes. The Inventory module counts paper, ink and stationery by SKU and unit, and every sale or use moves the stock.

faqs.q: Can I send quotes and invoices on WhatsApp?
faqs.a: Yes. Share any quote, invoice or receipt on WhatsApp or by email as a link or a PDF.
Quotes, invoices, customers and payments are free forever. Add Manufacturing, Inventory, CRM or Delivery when you need them and pay only for those modules.

ctaTitle: Run your print shop from one screen
ctaSub: Start with free quotes and invoices, then add job tracking and paper stock when you are ready.
